prop:source-bound.title: Scaled source control of physical stationarity
prop:source-bound.note: Proved. The positive source space with Gram G_h is a real inner-product space W (its norm is the G_h norm); the finite action covector a_h is a continuous linear functional a : W ->L[R] R whose operator norm is the dual norm ||a_h||_{G_h^{-1}} (source_bound), equivalently the G_h-norm of its Riesz representative alpha (source_bound_riesz, using innerSL_apply_norm). The test space V is any real normed space (the C^{r_0} norm), v_h : V -> W the source lift, and Phi v = D S_h(z_h^d)[I_h v]. stationarityDefect Phi := iSup over the unit ball of |Phi v| encodes eps_h(K) of eq:stationarity. From ||a||^2 <= R_h, ||v_h(v)|| <= L_h ||v|| and |Phi v - a(v_h v)| <= e_h ||v||, source_bound_pointwise gives |Phi v| <= (L_h sqrt R_h + e_h)||v|| (Cauchy-Schwarz = ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm, sqrt monotonicity, triangle inequality) and source_bound gives eps_h(K) <= L_h sqrt R_h + e_h (ciSup_le over the nonempty unit ball). The 'in particular' clause is source_bound_tendsto: along a regulator sequence, L_h sqrt R_h + e_h -> 0 forces eps_h(K) -> 0 (squeeze_zero with stationarityDefect_nonneg_of_bound). Scoped hypotheses disclosed: the constants L_h, e_h are taken nonnegative (needed only to pass from the ||v||-scaled bound to the unit-ball supremum); the lift v_h need not be linear; the earlier pointer gt_protected_riesz was not needed.

Yukawa blocks: higgsConj = i sigma_2 conj(H) with higgsConj_mulVec (i sigma_2 conj(UH) = conj(det U) U i sigma_2 conj(H) for U in U(2)); the mass map assembled from Qbar Htilde Y_u u_R + Qbar H Y_d d_R + Lbar H Y_e e_R + h.c. (yukawaMin) and, on the neutral extension, Lbar Htilde Y_nu nu_R + h.c. plus the constant symmetric Majorana block (M_R^T = M_R) on nu_R + nu_R^c (yukawaExt), on the carrier (Q_L + L_L) + (u_R + d_R + e_R) [+ (nu_R + nu_R^c)] tensored with the generation factor C^3; covariance rho(g) M(H) = M(rho_H(g) H) rho(g) for the unitary fermion representation (yukawaMin_covariant, yukawaExt_covariant), hence invariance of the Hermitian mass bilinear Psi^dagger M Psi (bilinear_invariant). Affinity in real Higgs coordinates: M(H) = M(0) + L(H) with L real-linear and M(0) the Majorana block (yukawaExt_affine). eq:yukawa-bound on a bank with all Yukawa/Majorana entries <= R: entries of M(H) <= R(1+|H|), M(H+eta) - M(H) = L(eta) with entries <= R|eta| (yukawa_bound). Renderings: the bound is entrywise (finite-dimensional norm equivalence gives the operator-norm form up to a dimension constant), |H| is the sup norm on C^2; the spacetime-chirality column of the table and the Dirac gamma structure are not part of this internal statement.

lem:native-discrete-KR.title: Discrete translation compactness
lem:native-discrete-KR.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: discrete translation compactness, Kolmogorov-Riesz, Frechet-Kolmogorov, uniform L^2 translation modulus, piecewise-constant reconstruction R_h^0. Mathlib has no Kolmogorov-Riesz (Frechet-Kolmogorov) compactness theorem in L^2.
lem:native-discrete-KR.plan: Requires the Kolmogorov-Riesz theorem for L^2 on a bounded 4D region (uniform boundedness + uniform translation modulus implies precompactness), transported to piecewise-constant reconstructions of grid functions (the translation modulus of R_h^0 u_h at scale rho is controlled by the discrete moduli at |m| h <= rho plus an O(h) term). lem:native-discrete-Hodge.title: Exact periodic discrete Hodge identity
lem:native-discrete-Hodge.note: periodicHodge_identity: on any finite additive commutative group X (the periodic grid, e.g. (ZMod N)^4) with lattice steps e_mu, directions a finite linearly ordered type (Fin 4), values in a real inner product space (Lie algebra with invariant inner product), and every mesh h, sum_{mu,nu} ||D^+_mu A_nu||^2_{2,h} = ||d_h^+ A||^2_{2,h} + ||delta_h A||^2_{2,h}, with ||u||^2_{2,h} = h^{dim} sum_x |u(x)|^2, D^+ forward difference, delta_h A = -sum_mu D^-_mu A_mu (eq:native-discrete-divergence), ||d^+A||^2 = sum_{mu<nu} ||D^+_mu A_nu - D^+_nu A_mu||^2. Proof in position space (translation invariance of periodic sums) rather than Fourier. periodicHodge_H1_bound: for h >= 0, ||A||_{1,h} <= 1*(||d^+A|| + ||delta A|| + ||A||_{2,h}) with ||A||^2_{1,h} = sum_nu ||A_nu||^2 + sum_{mu,nu} ||D^+_mu A_nu||^2 (C = 1, uniform in h).

Hard.

lem:native-log-gauge-differential.title: Exact logarithmic site-gauge differential
lem:native-log-gauge-differential.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: logarithmic site gauge, gauge differential, ad_A, dexp inverse series K(Z), site-gauge energy differential, delta_h A. Algebra/SeriesLogUnitConjugation.lean only proves conjugation equivariance of the series logarithm, not its derivative along a gauge curve.

Mathlib has the exponential series and its derivative only at commuting arguments; the derivative of log in a normed algebra (Algebra/SeriesLogUnitConjugation.lean, DiscreteAnalysis/ShiftedPlaquetteLogarithmExact.lean provide the series and analyticity) plus the dexp inverse identity is new infrastructure. The energy identity eq:native-gauge-energy-differential then follows by summation by parts. Hard.

prop:rooted-gauge-certificate.title: Rooted same-record gauge certificate
prop:rooted-gauge-certificate.note: Partial: the endpoint-cancellation algebra is proved for any group and any family of walks to the root (a rooted spanning tree in particular): RootedWilson.rootedPath_gaugeLinks C_x(U^k) = k_o C_x(U) k_x^{-1}; rootedWord_gaugeLinks W(U^k) = k_o W(U) k_o^{-1}; every class function of the rooted words is site-gauge invariant (classFunction_rootedWord_gaugeLinks); the tree representative is an exact gauge transform (rootedWord_eq_gaugeLinks) and trivial on tree edges; central root gauges leave rooted words unchanged. (3) The Coulomb clause inherits thm:finite-Coulomb-normalization (hard).

lem:determinant-screen-flux.title: Determinant compactness, admissibility, and flux
lem:determinant-screen-flux.note: Partial: all exact finite clauses are proved. DeterminantFlux.determinant_screen_flux_exact, for G_SM links U on (Z/n)^4 with principal determinant arguments phi = Arg chi(P_U) (eq:determinant-real-curvature): (1) f_h = l_c(F_h): every logarithm L of a full plaquette with entries <= c, 2c < min(pairChart, pi), has l_c(L) = phi (uses det exp = exp tr, MatrixDetExp); (2) if max|phi| < pi/3 then d_h f_h = 0 exactly (cubeSum_eq_zero: the six cube plaquettes multiply to one, the argument sum is 2 pi k with |.| < 2 pi); (3) every periodic coordinate-plane flux is 2 pi m, m integer (planeFlux_integer, telescoping product); (4) it is independent of the transverse base point (planeFlux_shift, planeFlux_const); (5) n^2 sum_x phi = n^4 2 pi m, i.e. mean curvature = 2 pi m / L^2 (sum_phase_eq_flux, mean_curvature_eq_flux); (6) 2 pi |m_{mu nu}| <= ||f_{mu nu}||_{2,h} (two_pi_abs_flux_le, Cauchy-Schwarz). Missing: the analytic clauses: max_x |phi_h| -> 0 and admissibility for small h from bounded curvature with vanishing adjoint Wilson modulus (thm:native-Wilson-compactness, open/hard), the modulus transfer omega_h(f) <= C Omega_h(F) and L^2 precompactness of R_h^0 f_h (lem:native-discrete-KR, open/hard), and the (elementary) constant subsequence of the bounded integer vectors m_h.
lem:determinant-screen-flux.plan: Remaining: prove eventual uniform smallness of h^2 F_h from the scalar-magnitude part of thm:native-Wilson-compactness, the transfer of the adjoint Wilson difference through the Ad-invariant functional l_c, and Kolmogorov-Riesz precompactness (lem:native-discrete-KR); then combine with determinant_screen_flux_exact. The subsequence clause: bounded integer vectors (2 pi |m_h| <= ||f_h|| <= C) take finitely many values, pigeonhole.

prop:periodic-determinant-normalization.title: Zero-flux Abelian normalization with unrestricted flat holonomy
prop:periodic-determinant-normalization.note: Partial: the exact gauge construction (eq:determinant-Abelian-normalization) is proved given the primitive. DeterminantFlux.periodic_abelian_normalization: for periodic U(1) (Circle) links u on (Z/n)^iota and a real a0 with h*h(d_h a0) = Arg p_u (i.e. d_h a0 = f), there are constants c_mu with L c_mu in (-pi, pi] (L = n h) equal to the principal argument of the (base-point independent) cycle holonomy of the flat residual u e^{-iha0}, and real site phases t with e^{it(x)} u_mu(x) e^{-it(x+mu)} = e^{ih(a0+c)_mu(x)}, delta_h(a0+c) = delta_h a0; no smallness of f, a0 or the cycle phases is used. Infrastructure: for any commutative group, flat cycle holonomies are base-point independent (cycProd_add_unitStep, cycProd_const), gauges preserve plaquettes and cycle holonomies, and a flat field with trivial cycle holonomies is pure gauge (pureGauge_of_flat, by successive line gauges). Missing: (i) the existence of the Hodge primitive a0 = delta_h Delta_h^dagger f_h with d_h a0 = f_h, delta_h a0 = 0 for closed zero-flux f (finite linear algebra, absent); (ii) the raw L^4 / L^2 / H^1 precompactness of the coordinates and h||a_h||_inf -> 0 (continuum; needs lem:determinant-Hodge-stability and lem:determinant-screen-flux, both open).

(2) The precompactness clauses inherit the hard continuum machinery of lem:determinant-Hodge-stability (strong L^2 convergence of Fourier tails, reconstruction identification) and of lem:determinant-screen-flux. prop:native-determinant-split.title: Exact determinant normalization and semisimple remainder
prop:native-determinant-split.note: Partial; corollary policy (its parents prop:periodic-determinant-normalization and lem:determinant-screen-flux remain open). New infrastructure: det(exp X) = exp(tr X) for square matrices over R or C (MatrixDetExp.det_exp_eq_exp_trace, Liouville ODE argument; MatrixDetExp.det_exp_eq_complex_exp_trace), and the local injectivity chart of the matrix exponential (exists_openPartialHomeomorph_exp, exists_injOn_exp_entry_ball). With them: chi(e^X) = e^{i l_c(X)} (smChi_eq_exp_ellC); a fixed injectivity radius pairChart of the pair exponential (pairChart_injOn); logarithms of G_SM elements in the chart are anti-Hermitian, so l_c is real and, for entries <= c with 2c < min(pairChart, pi), l_c(L) = Arg chi(P) (ellC_eq_arg_smChi: f_h = l_c(F_h)). native_determinant_split_of_small_logs discharges the abstract chart Omega and the identity l_c(L) = h^2 f of native_determinant_split_core: f is now the principal-argument curvature h^-2 Arg chi(P_U) of eq:determinant-real-curvature, the logs only need to be small. native_determinant_split_of_primitive (periodic grid (Z/n)^iota): from a real primitive a0 of the determinant curvature (h*h(d_h a0) = Arg chi(P_U)) and small logarithms of the full plaquettes, it constructs (periodic_abelian_normalization) constants c_mu in (-pi/L, pi/L] and real site lifts t with e^{it} chi(U) e^{-it(x+mu)} = e^{ih(a0+c)}, delta(a0+c) = delta a0, and then all conclusions: V in G_ss exactly, P_{U'} = e^{h^2 f Z_c} P_V, chart log of P_V = Pi_ss L (eq:determinant-semisimple-curvature), Ad V = Ad U', central lift changes; P_{U'} = P_U (plaq_gaugeTr_centralElem). Certificate clause proved directly without prop:rooted-gauge-certificate: the lift change t -> t + 2 pi k acts by the central G_ss gauge z6^k, which leaves every rooted word W^T of V and every plaquette of V unchanged (RootedWilson.splitLinks_rootedWord_lift_change, splitLinks_plaq_lift_change), hence the rooted certificate. Non-vacuity: example with trivial links in DeterminantFluxExact.lean. Missing inputs (open parents): the existence of the Hodge primitive a0 = delta_h Delta_h^dagger f_h with d_h a0 = f_h (finite linear algebra, part of lem:determinant-Hodge-stability / prop:periodic-determinant-normalization), and the eventual smallness of the scaled full curvature from the Wilson screen (lem:determinant-screen-flux via thm:native-Wilson-compactness).
prop:native-determinant-split.plan: Close by instantiating native_determinant_split_of_primitive once (1) the discrete Hodge primitive exists: for a closed (cubeSum_eq_zero) zero-flux real 2-form f on (Z/n)^4, a0 = delta_h Delta_h^dagger f satisfies d_h a0 = f, delta_h a0 = 0 (needs: ker Delta_h on 2-forms = constants via DiscreteAnalysis/LatticeTorusPlancherel.lean Fourier diagonalisation, closed + zero-mean => no harmonic part); (2) lem:determinant-screen-flux supplies, for h small, logarithms of the full plaquettes with entries <= c, 2c < min(pairChart, pi) (eventual uniform smallness of h^2 F_h from thm:native-Wilson-compactness); and (3) prop:periodic-determinant-normalization / lem:determinant-screen-flux are closed in the ledger (their remaining clauses are the continuum precompactness statements). No further group algebra is needed; the certificate clause is already proved via the central-gauge invariance of rooted words.

lem:native-plaquette.title: Regularity of the plaquette map
lem:native-plaquette.note: Proved in a real Banach algebra 𝔄 with ‖1‖ = 1 (NormOneClass; scoped hypothesis, as in the previous partial), for X, Y, a, b in 𝔄. Bundled statement exists_joint_analytic_extension: there is Φ : ℝ × 𝔄⁴ → 𝔄 (jointLogPlaquette) with (i) Φ analytic at every (0, X, Y, a, b), (ii) Φ(0; X,Y,a,b) = a - b + [X,Y], (iii) h² Φ(h) = log(e^{hX} e^{h(Y+ha)} e^{-h(X+hb)} e^{-hY}) for all h ≠ 0 with the series logarithm log(1+z) = z Σ (-1)^n z^n/(n+1), and (iv) for every order k and every compact set K of parameters there are h₀ > 0 and C with ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Φ (h, q)‖ ≤ C for |h| ≤ h₀ and q ∈ K, i.e. all fixed-order derivatives in h and in the parameters are uniformly bounded on compact argument sets for small h (second sentence of the lemma). The 'analytic branch' is identified: exp(log(1+z)) = 1 + z for ‖z‖ < 1 (exp_logOneAdd, proved by differentiating t ↦ exp(-log(1+tz))(1+tz) with a Commute-based derivative of exp, no commutativity of 𝔄 needed), hence exp(h² Φ(h)) = P(h) whenever ‖P(h) - 1‖ < 1 (exp_sq_smul_logPlaquette). Method for (i)/(iv): exp u = 1 + u + u² E(u) with E entire (exp_eq_expRemainder), giving the explicit removable quotient P(h) - 1 = h² Q(h; X,Y,a,b) with Q a polynomial in h, X, Y, a, b and the E(h v_i) (product_sub_one_eq), equal to the dslope quotient of the previous partial for every h (quotient_eq_quotientPoly); Φ = Q · L(h² Q) is then jointly analytic on the open set ‖h² Q‖ < 1 ⊇ {0} × 𝔄⁴, and the bound (iv) follows by continuity of iteratedFDeriv on a compact tube [-h₀, h₀] × K (generalized tube lemma). Not restated separately: the one-variable h-derivatives are directional derivatives of the joint Fréchet derivatives, so they are covered by (iv).

lem:native-action-Hessian.title: Uniform upper Hessian scale of the local action
lem:native-action-Hessian.note: Proved as the corollary of the now-proved parent lem:native-firstjet-normal-form. exists_hessian_bounds: for every compact set K of shifted first jets inside the nondegenerate chart there are h0 > 0 and constants C1, K0, D0 (independent of h and of the number of nodes n; explicitly C1 = C2 * 9, K0 = 17 C2 * 9, D0 = 2 C0 with C2, C0 the uniform bounds of D^2 F^(1) and F^(1) on K) such that for 0 < h <= h0 and every record y on the oriented logarithm chart whose stencils Xi_h y(x) all lie in K: |D^2 S_h^loc(y)[u,v]| <= C1 ||u||_{1,h} ||v||_{1,h} (eq:action-Hessian-bilinear), |D^2 S_h^loc(y)[u,v]| <= K0 h^{-2} ||u||_{0,h} ||v||_{0,h} (eq:action-Hessian-scale, the mass-norm operator bound), and |S_h^loc(y) - S_h^loc(y')| <= D0 (h^4 n^4) for every second such record y' (eq:action-span, with the h^4 x number-of-cells volume factor as in the paper). The Hessian is that of the actual local action localAction D h (the density chain, including the coframe/spin-connection chain, is differentiated throughout): on the open chart S_h^loc coincides with the shifted-first-jet action (localAction_eventuallyEq), so its iterated derivatives are those of the bulk representative (iteratedFDeriv_localAction_eq), to which the local (ContDiffAt-along-the-record) chain rule iteratedFDeriv_action_of_contDiffAt and the bounds abs_iteratedFDeriv_action_le_of_contDiffAt / _mass_of_contDiffAt apply with M = C2 (via norm_iteratedFDeriv_partial_le, the jet-derivative of F^(1)(h,.) is bounded by the joint derivative); the oscillation uses ShiftedJetAction.abs_action_sub_le with B = C0. Renderings disclosed: the 'compact convex subchart with all shifted first-jet arguments in a common compact coefficient set' is rendered as the compact set K of jets in the chart together with the oriented log-chart conditions on the record; h0 <= 1 is taken from the compact chart (the mass bound uses h <= 1 as in the parent file); upper bounds only, no positivity is asserted.

prop:normal-source.title: Tangential stationarity and the missing normal row
prop:normal-source.note: Proved, on arbitrary real normed spaces X_h, Z_h, P (more general than the finite Hilbert space of the paper), with S_h : X_h → ℝ, C_h : X_h → Z_h, DS_h(x_h) = fderiv ℝ S x, DC_h(x_h) = fderiv ℝ C x, B_h a right inverse of DC_h(x_h) (surjectivity follows, constraintNormal_surjective), P_h = I − B_h DC_h (constraintNormalProjector) and a continuous linear lift I_h. normalSource_bound / normalSource_iSup_bound: under ‖P_h I_h v‖ ≤ L^tan, ‖DC_h I_h v‖ ≤ L^nor for ‖v‖ ≤ 1, |DS_h[w]| ≤ a_h‖w‖ on ker DC_h and |DS_h[B_h q]| ≤ b_h‖q‖, one has sup_{‖v‖≤1} |DS_h(x_h)[I_h v]| ≤ a_h L^tan + b_h L^nor (eq:normal-source-bound), via P_h w ∈ ker DC_h and w = P_h w + B_h DC_h w. normalSource_counterexample: S(x,y) = x² + y, C(x,y) = y — DS(0,0) vanishes on ker DC(0,0) (restricted stationarity) but DS(0,0)[(0,1)] = 1, the 'In particular' clause. Scoped hypotheses disclosed: a_h, b_h ≥ 0 (implicit constants of the covector bounds).

prop:constraint-extension.title: Residual-preserving extension of a constrained identity
prop:constraint-extension.note: Proved. Chart (s,c) ∈ E_s × E_c (real normed spaces), J : E_s × E_c → F C¹ into a complete normed space F (matrix-valued maps: F = matrices with any norm), D_cJ(s,c) = fderiv of c' ↦ J(s,c'). constraintExtension_ftc: eq:constraint-extension J(s,c) = J(s,0) + ∫₀¹ D_cJ(s,tc)[c] dt (FTC along the normal segment). constraintTracking: for ċ = A(t)c + r(t) on [0,T] with ∫₀ᵀ‖A‖ ≤ M and ‖c(0)‖ + ∫₀ᵀ‖r‖ ≤ C a^p, ‖c(t)‖ ≤ C e^M a^p for all t ∈ [0,T] (eq:constraint-tracking), from the Gronwall bound constraintTracking_le ‖c(t)‖ ≤ e^M(‖c(0)‖ + ∫₀ᵀ‖r‖), proved by an ε-perturbed comparison function e^{∫₀ᵗ‖A‖}(‖c(0)‖ + ε + ∫₀ᵗ‖r‖ + εt) and Mathlib's image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary. constraintExtension_matrix_estimate: ‖D_cJ‖ ≤ L uniformly gives ‖J(s(t),c(t)) − J(s(t),0)‖ ≤ L·C e^M a^p on [0,T] (the O(a^p) matrix estimate). Scoped hypotheses disclosed: the tracking equation holds classically (c continuous on [0,T] with right derivative A(t)c(t) + r(t) on [0,T), A and r continuous on [0,T]) rather than in the Carathéodory/L¹ sense. The closing caveat (no estimate for an independent state-only source f(s,c); constant J counterexample) is commentary and not formalized.
